items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: I was workin' with Charlie Johnson's band at Small's Paradise when I did all the recording.

ctx.x: talking about? [ ], I was workin' with Charlie Johnson's band at Small's Paradise when I did all the recording. You see, like I was saying - I was recommended by Cy St. Clair, and Cy St. Clair was workin' with me every night. See what I mean, that's who recommended me, see, so - if Cy St. Clair wasn't there on those records you have, then I wasn't there, you see? You have to have, if Cy St. Clair was there before me and made every session with me on tuba - so I don't know, I mean, if you don't have Cy St. Clair…

items.title: Benny Waters interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 1, 1995
items.q: It’s called the “Charlie Johnson’s Paradise Ten.” That’s the name of the band, see? Charlie Johnson’s Paradise Ten.

ctx.x: It’s called the “Charlie Johnson’s Paradise Ten.” That’s the name of the band, see? Charlie Johnson’s Paradise Ten.
You are one of the musicians that decided to live in Europe for a while.
